comparator_in_same_job.limitation: Different Cargo invocation/feature graph and time; passing captured test does not expose exact warm latency.

conclusions: The original strict 500 ms gate failed on the recorded checkout. The failure is not waived.
The only index corpus case sets full=true; each repeated warm call performs a full rebuild in a reused MCP session.
With one index case the reported p95 is the best of its two measured calls after one discarded warmup. Percentile helper consolidation cannot alter a one-element result.
The benchmark and corpus integration tests copy fixtures into separate temporary roots and disable auto-index for fresh fixtures. No direct shared SQLite database collision is established.
eval-http adds optional reqwest and adapter code; the observed lib test inventories have the same count. This does not prove the full Cargo feature graphs or binary behavior identical.
No leaked CPU child from the reviewed resource-probe controls was demonstrated. Those controls explicitly kill and wait for their child.

Source admission and successful default tests do not establish performance acceptance. Current evidence cannot distinguish product regression, feature/build differences, scheduling, or runner pressure.

recommended_control.build: Use separate clean worktrees/private targets with exact rustc 1.99.0 and original RUSTFLAGS/CARGO_INCREMENTAL. Build all targets via original cargo command plus --no-run --message-format=json before any timed run. Bind emitted lib executable, compiler profile/features, source/fixture/corpus hashes.

cells.A: baseline lib suite, original harness concurrency
cells.C: candidate lib suite, original harness concurrency

recommended_control.execution: Fresh process per cell, no overlapping build or other matrix cell. Run bound executable from crates/cc-eval with --nocapture and optional --test-threads=1. Preserve default ignored tests and all existing assertions. Record --list inventories, every exit/result, stdout/stderr, /usr/bin/time -v and available cgroup cpu.stat before/after. Never set RAYON_NUM_THREADS to mask behavior.
recommended_control.followup_feature_control: Only if the same-source concurrency contrast remains ambiguous, compare explicit package default and eval-http artifacts under the same suite/schedule and exact pinned build metadata.
outcome_constraints: Candidate serial failures with baseline serial passes support a source-performance regression; investigate the real full-index phase.
Normal-only failures reproducible across both versions support scheduling sensitivity; they do not by themselves authorize weakening CI.
Candidate-only concurrency sensitivity remains a product-by-load interaction, not proof of a harmless flaky test.
If every planned cell passes, the original failure remains unexplained; do not call it repaired.
No threshold, corpus full flag, original assertion, test selection or historical CI predicate may be changed as a way to obtain green.
Diagnostic runs do not replace successful original CI at a final reviewed commit.
